column1: # tools/css/gen-atrule-tables.py: what an at-rule requires, from the served drafts (read 2026-10-29). Tab separated: at-rule (without the `@`), when, descriptors (comma separated),
# effect, the sentence that decides it.
#  when     always | system:NAME (a @counter-style by the value of its `system`) | name:VALUE (a @color-profile by its name)
#  effect   ignore-rule (the rule is invalid and ignored whole) | defines-nothing (the rule is valid and defines nothing)

column5: Fonts 4, 4.1: "@font-face rules require a font-family and src descriptor; if either of these are missing, the @font-face rule must not be considered" (and the changes: "the font-family and src descriptors are no longer required for validity, as they can be added later by script")
Fonts 4, 9.2: "@font-palette-values rules require a font-family descriptor; if it is missing, the @font-palette-values rule is invalid and must be ignored entirely"
Counter Styles 3, 3.1.2: "If the system is cyclic, the symbols descriptor must contain at least one counter symbol, otherwise the rule does not define a counter style (but is still a valid rule)"
Counter Styles 3, 3.1.3: "the symbols descriptor must contain at least one counter symbol, otherwise the rule does not define a counter style (but is still a valid rule)"

Counter Styles 3, 3.1.5: "If the system is alphabetic, the symbols descriptor must contain at least two counter symbols, otherwise the rule does not define a counter style (but is still a valid rule)"

Counter Styles 3, 3.1.7: "If the system is additive, the additive-symbols descriptor must contain at least one additive tuple, otherwise the rule does not define a counter style (but is still a valid rule)"
Color 5, 4.4: a color profile without a src is not usable (device-cmyk needs components)
